xwikidoc.title: Import of the Migration Notes
xwikidoc.content:
{{velocity}} ## The import rewrites release notes across the wiki and cannot be undone, so administering the wiki is what it ## takes to run it, and to see what it would do. The script service checks it too; the check is also made here so that ## the form is not offered to someone who cannot use it. The document enforces wiki_admin as a required right: that is ## what refuses edit on this page to anyone who does not already hold the right the check tests for. #set ($hasWikiAdmin = $services.security.authorization.hasAccess('admin', $doc.documentReference.wikiReference)) #if (!$hasWikiAdmin) {{error}}{{translation key="releasenotes.migrationImport.notAllowed"/}}{{/error}} #else #set ($product = $stringtool.trim("$!request.product")) #if ($product == '') #set ($product = "$!services.releasenotes.getDefaultProduct()") #end ## The import only runs on a request carrying a valid form token; any other request only previews it, which writes ## nothing. #set ($run = ("$!request.action" == 'import' && $services.csrf.isTokenValid($request.getParameter('form_token')))) {{translation key="releasenotes.migrationImport.description"/}} {{html clean="false"}}
{{/html}} #if ("$!request.action" != '' && $product != '') #try('importException') #if ($run) #set ($report = $services.releasenotesMigrationImport.importNotes($product)) #else #set ($report = $services.releasenotesMigrationImport.preview($product)) #end #end #if ($importException) {{error}}$services.localization.render('releasenotes.migrationImport.failed', [$services.rendering.escape("$!importException.message", 'xwiki/2.1')]){{/error}} #else #if ($run) #set ($created = 0) #set ($rewritten = 0) #foreach ($item in $report.releaseNotes) #set ($created = $created + $item.createdEntries.size()) #if ($item.rewritten) #set ($rewritten = $rewritten + 1) #end #end (% class="box successmessage" %)((($services.localization.render('releasenotes.migrationImport.done', [$created, $rewritten])))) #else (% class="box infomessage" %)((($services.localization.render('releasenotes.migrationImport.summary', [$report.noteCount, $report.rewriteCount, $report.alreadyMigrated])))) #end #foreach ($item in $report.releaseNotes) ## The version and the titles are data of the release notes, emitted into wiki syntax, so they are escaped. #set ($escapedVersion = $services.rendering.escape($item.version, 'xwiki/2.1')) #set ($escapedReference = $services.rendering.escape($services.model.serialize($item.reference, 'default'), 'xwiki/2.1')) == [[$escapedVersion>>doc:$escapedReference]] == #if ("$!item.error" != '') (% class="box errormessage" %)((($services.localization.render('releasenotes.migrationImport.error', [$services.rendering.escape($item.error, 'xwiki/2.1')])))) #end #if (!$item.notes.isEmpty()) {{translation key="releasenotes.migrationImport.notes"/}} #foreach ($note in $item.notes) * $services.rendering.escape($note.title, 'xwiki/2.1') #end #end #if (!$item.duplicates.isEmpty()) {{translation key="releasenotes.migrationImport.duplicates"/}} #foreach ($duplicate in $item.duplicates) * $services.rendering.escape($duplicate, 'xwiki/2.1') #end #end #if (!$item.leftovers.isEmpty()) {{translation key="releasenotes.migrationImport.leftovers"/}} #foreach ($leftover in $item.leftovers) * $services.localization.render("releasenotes.migrationImport.leftover.${leftover.kind}")~: $services.rendering.escape($leftover.text, 'xwiki/2.1') #end #end #end #if ($report.releaseNotes.isEmpty()) {{translation key="releasenotes.migrationImport.nothing"/}} #end #end #end #end {{/velocity}}
